guard: manifest cwd reaches the real child through the registered launch endpoint and relative paths resolve on the manager host
why: Issue #963: the manifest resolver rejects cwd before it can reach a multi-repository fleet.
The CLI unit test drives resolve, prepare and launch-spec projection. This suite crosses the registered
manager launch endpoint with that field and reads process.cwd() written by an actual spawned child.
A manager row alone could repeat the requested path while the process runs elsewhere.

mutations.name: manifest launch drops cwd before startAgent
mutations.expectRed: manifest cwdrelative runs in the declared manager-host directory
mutations.cell: manifest cwdrelative runs in the declared manager-host directory

mutations.name: relative cwd resolves against the manager process cwd instead of its workspace
mutations.find: const cwd = opts.cwd ? resolve(this.workspaceRoot, opts.cwd) : this.workspaceRoot;
mutations.expectRed: manifest cwdrelative runs in the declared manager-host directory
mutations.cell: manifest cwdrelative runs in the declared manager-host directory
